# Full game quality review — 4 October 2026

Baseline is published DEV15.54, source `be3a698e0ad8bedb91e877b9932a7bb05b80684a`, immutable artifact `11284088414` from run `37151451383`. The root repository is incomplete and historical main must not be rebuilt.

`prepare.py ORIGINAL OUT [overrides.json] [production]` verifies the baseline PCK SHA256, copies its nine distribution files and appends only the explicit source overrides and isolated QA fixture. With no list, every production payload remains byte-identical. Existing packed QA is copied into `full_quality_base.gd`; the new fixture inherits it. Generated QA packages are **not publishable**: pass `production` to omit new fixtures and guarded legacy fixture repairs; the ordinary production startup is checked separately. Those repairs retain every existing assertion: premium-core expects completed pins to retire, and one-point-zero-world excavates its buried ore/cache targets with real terrain damage before testing claims. The world fixture's published bytecode and corresponding unchanged canonical source are both SHA256-guarded.

`review.mjs` exercises real Chromium touch in the actual candidate, storing a JPEG plus exact game state for every capture. It records GPU/browser/viewport/DPR/source/package identity, first-run 0–10s, movement, Skills/settings/achievements/full inventory/companion, surface and underground maps, commerce families, treasury entry/delivery/exit, mod previews and all four biomes at 667/844/932 CSS widths. Fixtures seed explicit progression states; this is not a blind player journey or physical iPhone/FPS evidence. The unchanged ordinary WebKit startup is a separate capture set. Review screenshots, not only job status.

For candidate source changes, list **only** intended production resource paths in `overrides.json`; later builders must preserve unlisted originals. `native.py` runs focused regression tools against the exact production pack and retains the existing input, premium-core, endgame and one-point-zero-world gates against the review-only fixture overlay. The user requested a checkpoint after each source change; the parent agent owns those commits and publication.

The independent recovery job produces SHA256-verified chunks of at most28MiB, each uploaded separately. Download each small artifact; concatenate `.bin` in manifest order, verify the archive hash and unzip. Future review pushes can use `[qa-no-runtime]` in the commit title to avoid downloading the already recovered native runtime. Broad CI starts only when `.github/full-quality/run.json` changes, or by workflow_dispatch; routine source and QA checkpoints do not retrigger it. No credentials or real player saves are captured.

`journey.mjs` exercises a fresh game with actual touch for entering/leaving the first mine, mining natural untouched terrain, collecting its real drop, entering the automatic Assay sale, buying two upgrades, and opening the first gate. Fixtures only place the player and explicitly top up the purchase gold. It also records eight-second rendered frame/CPU windows on surface, depth two, and Deep. These are hosted Mac GPU observations, not a physical-device performance claim.

Game-data overrides are restricted to the four Running achievement description leaves and the corresponding source-manifest hash. All other data is required to match the immutable baseline. Every unlisted PCK payload remains byte-identical, even where the historical source-only invariant snapshot is unavailable in this partial checkout.

The finale group seeds only its prerequisites and player placement, then uses actual held Mine for all four seals and touch for core activation, conclusion navigation and the Hub elevator into Deep. Conclusion captures cover all three widths. Achievement focus probes use actual toast touches and require the entire highlighted row inside its transformed scroll viewport for early, middle, Threefold Star and final entries; Back cancellation before deferred focus is a separately labelled signal-level race.

The final focused pass also seeds simultaneous presentation events for three pickups, a skill increase and an achievement. Production owners determine timing and placement. Actual rendered bounds must clear the hero, viewport and each other; touch opens the map and verifies notice suspension. Only the two changed hero visual owners are overlaid; the existing placement helper and pickup owner remain byte-identical to DEV15.54.
